description: Ingest issues from a Sentry project via the /api/0/projects/{org}/{project}/issues/ REST endpoint. Handles cursor pagination via the Link header. Returns a DataFrame with flattened issue fields.

outputs.description: pandas DataFrame with one row per vendor record. Chain a downstream sink component (dataframe_to_snowflake / _to_bigquery / _to_duckdb / ...) to persist.

api_host.description: Sentry host. Use 'https://sentry.io' (default) for SaaS or your self-hosted URL.
api_host.label: API Host

api_token_env_var.description: Env var holding the Sentry auth token (needs `project:read` scope).
api_token_env_var.label: API Token Env Var

query.description: Sentry search query. Examples: 'is:unresolved', 'is:resolved age:-24h', 'level:error'. See https://docs.sentry.io/product/sentry-basics/search/
query.label: Query

stats_period.description: Time range for the query (e.g. '24h', '7d', '30d'). None = default.
stats_period.label: Stats Period

limit.description: Total row cap across paginated pages.
limit.label: Limit

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include sample data preview in metadata

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: How many rows to include in the preview. Large tables (>10× this number) are sampled randomly.
